fleet.tombstoneMechanism: profiles/.deleted/<name>, 9 bytes each. Written by delete_profile under a live multiplexer.

blockers.title: Profile tree went 74 to 5, now 7
blockers.body: 66 tombstones at 15:20 ET, 64 now. Five of six SME targets in policy.json are gone, so every SME route is a dead letter. The 10-second cadence and the unserved log pattern look mechanical, not deliberate.

blockers.title: terminal.cwd points at a path that does not exist
blockers.body: Live value is m:/code/vidiflow/out. Every terminal call fails with exit 126. The very first tool call of the reporting session hit it.

blockers.title: mcp_servers has no kumiho block
blockers.body: The mcp package is installed and verified. This is the last hop to Kumiho and it is a config entry, not code.

blockers.title: Fallback chain is one entry against a six-provider intent
blockers.body: Only openrouter / stealth-space-bunny-alpha. One key dying takes the whole runtime with it.

blockers.title: policy.json profile names never matched the directory names
blockers.body: dex vs debug_dex, quinn vs qa_quinn, tess vs 3d_tess, hx vs vidiflow_vidibio_hx. Only airpmd matched, and it is tombstoned too.

blockers.title: Kumiho embedding returns 401 and fails silently
blockers.body: Small, separate, and it never surfaces an error on its own.

blockers.title: The router is a side script, not a plugin hook
blockers.body: The custom layer is the right shape but it is not wired into the runtime as a plugin, and the judge is unavailable so routing is heuristics-only.

blockers.title: Enhancement hook belongs on the write boundary
blockers.body: Auto-embed-on-read spends GPU on documents nobody asked about and gives the UI no way to show blocked-HITL during a render.
